What we'll cover

Three conversations, one governance backbone

01
OpenPages · Use case intake

Replace fragmented intake with one system of record

Intake today spans MS Forms, SharePoint lists and manual entry. OpenPages automates the workflow and enforces ownership at every stage.

  • MS Forms stays as the front end; OpenPages works behind it via API
  • Prioritization, approval and lifecycle oversight
  • Native webhooks notify downstream systems
02
OpenPages · Product updates & releases

Latest capabilities and platform integrations

A focused look at recent OpenPages releases — new features, performance improvements and expanded connectivity that streamline governance workflows.

  • Recent product enhancements and what they enable for your team
  • Integrations with leading cloud platforms for discovery and lifecycle management
  • Connectivity with observability tools for real-time oversight
03
Regulatory compliance management

Strengthen your compliance posture with OpenPages

Growing regulatory pressure (OSFI E-23) calls for an evidence-backed compliance posture, purpose-built for financial services.

  • Regulatory policy packs mapped to obligations, controls and evidence
  • Requirements traced to use cases, models and risk controls
  • Integrations with leading compliance and risk platforms
